issues.title_en: Politics of Panic: The high price of presidential insecurity in Malawi
issues.summary: By Rick Dzida Our constitution is actively draining Malawi’s national treasury. By framing the office of the Vice President as an automatic “President-in-waiting” who inherits the rest of a five-year term, the law builds a foundation of permanent political warfare. Presidents view their deputies as ambitious rivals waiting for them to fall. This paranoia triggers [...] The post Politics of Panic: The high price of presidential insecurity in Malawi appeared first on The Maravi Post .
